questionnaire.title: Enterprise Risk Management Candidate Profile
questionnaire.description: ERM-specific skills and experience (complements general candidate-profile)

0.label: No Experience
0.description: No exposure or experience in this area

1.label: Awareness
1.description: Understands concepts and can interpret outputs; works under supervision

2.label: Practical Application
2.description: Can apply and operate established frameworks; works independently

3.label: Implementation & Management
3.description: Can implement, adapt and manage frameworks; leads specific contexts

4.label: Strategic Leadership
4.description: Can design from first principles; creates methodologies; enterprise-wide scope

questionnaire.interviewNote: All self-assessed proficiency ratings are likely to be explored during interviews. Be prepared to provide specific examples demonstrating your claimed level of expertise.

sections.title: ERM Experience Overview
sections.description: Your Enterprise Risk Management specific background

questions.question: Highest Level of ERM Scope You Have Worked At
Your Total Risk/Audit/Control Experience
questions.description: From your main Candidate Profile, you indicated your total years in Risk, Audit or Control functions. Below, please break down how this time was spent across ERM-specific roles.
questions.helpText: This is pulled from your main Candidate Profile. To change your total years, update the Professional Experience section there.

questions.question: Of your total experience, how many years in Enterprise Risk Management?
questions.description: Years spent specifically in ERM roles (e.g., ERM Manager, Chief Risk Officer, Enterprise Risk Analyst). This should be less than or equal to your total risk/audit/control experience.
questions.helpText: Count only dedicated ERM/enterprise risk roles, not general risk or audit positions

questions.question: Of your total experience, how many years in broader Risk Management?
questions.description: Years in any risk management discipline (operational risk, credit risk, market risk, IT risk, etc.) including ERM. This may equal your total risk/audit/control experience if you've always worked in risk.
questions.helpText: This should include your ERM years plus any other risk management experience

questions.question: Experience Breakdown (Optional)
questions.description: If helpful, provide a brief breakdown of how your experience is split across different risk/audit/control areas
questions.placeholder: e.g., '5 years ERM, 3 years operational risk, 2 years internal audit' or '8 years purely in ERM function'

questions.placeholder: e.g., 'Promoted twice in 4 years at [Company], from Risk Analyst to Senior Manager; Selected to lead enterprise-wide risk transformation programme over more senior candidates; Headhunted by current employer to build out their ERM function from scratch...'

questions.question: Your Unique Value
questions.description: What makes you stand out from other risk professionals? What unique combination of skills, experiences, or perspectives do you bring?
questions.placeholder: e.g., 'Combination of front-office trading experience with deep ERM expertise gives me credibility with the business; Fluent in Mandarin enabling direct engagement with APAC operations; Background in data science allows me to bridge gap between risk and analytics teams...'

questions.question: Anything Else?
questions.description: Is there anything else you would like us to know about your skills, experience, or candidacy that you haven't had the opportunity to share?
questions.placeholder: Use this space to share any additional information that would help us understand your candidacy...

sections.title: Transferable Technical Skills
sections.description: Technical skills from other domains that complement your ERM expertise
sections.helpText: Many ERM professionals bring valuable skills from adjacent disciplines. Select all that apply and indicate your proficiency level.

questions.question: Financial Analysis & Accounting
questions.description: Financial statement analysis, management accounting, budgeting, forecasting

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Can read and interpret financial statements; understands basic accounting principles
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Performed financial analysis; built financial models; contributed to budgeting processes
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Led financial analysis workstreams; designed financial models; managed P&L or cost centres
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Expert in financial analysis; qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CPA) or equivalent; led finance functions

questions.question: Strategy & Business Planning
questions.description: Strategic planning, business case development, market analysis, competitive intelligence

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Understands strategic planning concepts; participated in strategy discussions
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Contributed to strategic plans; developed business cases; conducted market analysis
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Led strategy workstreams; designed strategic frameworks; facilitated strategy sessions
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Directed corporate strategy; led M&A due diligence; established strategic planning processes

questions.question: Project & Programme Management
questions.description: Project management methodologies (PRINCE2, PMP, Agile), programme delivery, PMO

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Understands project management concepts; participated in project teams
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Managed projects; applied PM methodologies; tracked deliverables and milestones
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Led complex programmes; established PMO functions; certified PM (PRINCE2, PMP)
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Directed enterprise programme portfolios; transformed delivery capabilities; led large-scale transformations

questions.question: Data Science & Advanced Analytics
questions.description: Statistical analysis, machine learning, data visualisation, programming (Python, R, SQL)

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Understands data science concepts; can interpret analytical outputs
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Performed statistical analysis; built dashboards; basic programming skills
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Built predictive models; proficient in Python/R/SQL; designed analytical solutions
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Expert data scientist; led analytics teams; designed ML pipelines; published research

questions.question: Internal Audit
questions.description: Audit planning, fieldwork, reporting, IIA standards, SOX/internal controls testing

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Understands internal audit concepts; familiar with IIA standards
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Conducted audit fieldwork; documented findings; tested controls
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Led audit engagements; designed audit programmes; managed audit teams; CIA qualified
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Directed internal audit functions; established audit methodology; reported to Audit Committee

questions.question: Legal & Regulatory Affairs
questions.description: Contract review, regulatory interpretation, legal risk assessment, compliance frameworks

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Understands legal/regulatory concepts; can interpret regulations with guidance
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Reviewed contracts; interpreted regulatory requirements; supported compliance initiatives
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Led regulatory interpretation; designed compliance frameworks; managed legal workstreams
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Qualified lawyer or regulatory specialist; directed legal/regulatory functions; advised boards

questions.question: Operations & Process Improvement
questions.description: Process mapping, Lean/Six Sigma, operational efficiency, business process reengineering

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Understands process improvement concepts; participated in efficiency initiatives
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Mapped processes; identified inefficiencies; implemented improvements
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Led process transformation; Lean/Six Sigma certified (Green/Black Belt); designed operating models
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Directed operational excellence programmes; transformed enterprise operations; established continuous improvement culture

questions.question: Technology & IT Management
questions.description: IT strategy, systems architecture, software development, IT service management

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Understands IT concepts; can articulate technology requirements
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Managed IT projects; wrote technical specifications; worked with development teams
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Led IT initiatives; designed systems architecture; managed IT teams
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Directed IT functions; established technology strategy; led digital transformation

questions.question: HR & People Management
questions.description: Talent management, organisational development, change management, employee relations

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Understands HR concepts; managed small teams
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Led teams; conducted performance management; supported organisational change
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Designed organisational structures; led change programmes; managed large teams (10+)
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Directed HR/people functions; established talent strategies; led enterprise-wide change

questions.question: Commercial & Sales
questions.description: Commercial negotiation, sales management, client relationship management, pricing

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Understands commercial concepts; participated in client discussions
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Managed client relationships; contributed to commercial negotiations; supported sales processes
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Led commercial negotiations; managed sales teams; designed pricing strategies
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Directed commercial functions; established sales strategies; managed major client portfolios

questions.question: Sustainability & ESG
questions.description: ESG strategy, sustainability reporting, carbon accounting, stakeholder engagement

proficiencyDefinitions.1: Understands ESG concepts; familiar with sustainability frameworks (GRI, SASB, TCFD)
proficiencyDefinitions.2: Contributed to ESG reporting; supported sustainability initiatives; gathered ESG data
proficiencyDefinitions.3: Led ESG programmes; designed sustainability strategies; managed stakeholder engagement
proficiencyDefinitions.4: Directed ESG/sustainability functions; established enterprise ESG strategy; advised boards on sustainability

questions.question: Other Transferable Skills
questions.description: List any other technical skills from your background that you believe would add value in an ERM role
questions.placeholder: e.g., 'Actuarial qualifications (FIA) with pricing and reserving experience; Supply chain management expertise from 5 years in logistics; Treasury management including FX hedging and cash flow forecasting; Crisis communications and media relations training...'
